description: A modern residential pool perimeter exterior scene photographed at deep blue twilight. Two square concrete or cement pillar caps are set atop a low continuous garden wall that runs horizontally across the middle of the frame, separating a residential lawn in the foreground from a calm swimming pool behind. The pool surface is a moody teal-blue, partially visible above the wall, with the soft reflections of illuminated surrounding planting and a rock or boulder feature in the upper left. The wall surface is finished in smooth poured concrete or rendered stucco in a medium gray tone. The lawn in the foreground is clipped grass in dark muted green. Each pillar cap has a compact angular matte charcoal-dark fixture mounted on top that emits warm amber light, pooling sideways onto the upper surface of the concrete caps and creating soft halos below. The sky is a deep steel blue. The overall scene is serene, cool, and minimal — dark neutrals with paired warm amber glow accents. Camera is at a low angle of roughly 2-3 feet, looking level across the top of the wall toward the pool behind, showing both pillar caps in a three-quarter off-center composition with the pool as context. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
